section: Purpose and Scope of the Policy
chunk: The Code of Conduct & Ethics Policy serves as a guiding framework for all employees of Global Service Firm, regardless of their position or location. This policy aims to foster an ethical workplace that promotes integrity, respect, and accountability. It applies to all employees, contractors, and thirdparty representatives associated with the firm.

section: Purpose and Scope of the Policy
chunk: To establish clear expectations for ethical behavior. To protect the company’s reputation and assets. To ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

At Global Service Firm, our core values guide our actions and decisions. These values are: 1. Integrity: We conduct our business honestly and transparently. Example: An employee discovers a billing error that favors the company. They report it immediately to ensure transparency. 2. Respect: We treat everyone with dignity and consideration. Example: A team member actively listens to diverse opinions during meetings, fostering an inclusive environment. 3. Fairness: We strive for equitable treatment in all interactions. Example: Promotions are based on merit, ensuring all employees have equal opportunities. 4. Compliance with Laws: We adhere to all applicable local and international laws. Example: Employees are trained on data protection laws relevant to their region.

Employees are expected to maintain a high standard of professionalism in all interactions. Dress Code: Employees should dress appropriately for their role and work environment. Communication: Use respectful language in all forms of communication, whether in person, via email, or on social media.

Discrimination based on race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, or disability is strictly prohibited. Scenario: An employee overhears a colleague making derogatory remarks about another’s ethnicity. They are encouraged to report this behavior.
Harassment of any kind, including sexual harassment, is not tolerated. Example: Unwanted advances or inappropriate jokes create a hostile work environment and should be reported immediately.
Ensure all team members understand workplace behavior standards. Provide training on diversity and inclusion. Encourage open dialogue about workplace conduct.
Employees must avoid situations where personal interests conflict with the interests of Global Service Firm.
Personal Relationships: Hiring or supervising a family member. Financial Interests: Holding a significant financial stake in a competitor.
Employees must disclose any potential conflicts to their manager or HR.
Accepting gifts from clients or suppliers that exceed a nominal value. Engaging in outside employment that interferes with job performance.
Regularly review team members for potential conflicts of interest. Encourage transparency in all business dealings. Provide guidance on acceptable gift policies.

Employees must protect sensitive information related to the company, clients, and colleagues. Data Handling: Follow company protocols for data storage and sharing. Confidential Information: Do not disclose proprietary information without authorization.
An employee receives a request for client data from an external party. They must verify the request’s legitimacy before sharing any information.
Conduct regular training on data protection policies. Ensure secure data storage practices are followed. Monitor compliance with confidentiality agreements.

section: Use of Company Assets and IT Resources
chunk: Company assets, including IT resources, should be used responsibly and primarily for business purposes.

section: Use of Company Assets and IT Resources
chunk: Using company email for workrelated communication. Accessing the internet for research relevant to job responsibilities.

section: Use of Company Assets and IT Resources
chunk: Downloading unauthorized software. Using company resources for personal financial gain.

section: Use of Company Assets and IT Resources
chunk: Monitor the use of company assets and IT resources. Provide guidelines on acceptable use. Address misuse promptly.
Global Service Firm has a zerotolerance policy towards bribery and corruption.
Never offer or accept bribes in any form. Maintain transparency in all financial transactions.
An employee is offered a payment in exchange for favorable treatment. They must refuse and report the incident.
Provide training on antibribery policies. Ensure all contracts include anticorruption clauses. Monitor compliance with ethical standards.

section: Interactions with Clients, Partners, and Suppliers
chunk: All interactions must reflect our commitment to integrity and professionalism.

section: Interactions with Clients, Partners, and Suppliers
chunk: Treat all clients and partners with respect and fairness. Avoid any actions that could damage the company’s reputation.

section: Interactions with Clients, Partners, and Suppliers
chunk: A supplier offers a discount for a future project in exchange for a contract. This should be reported as a potential conflict of interest.

section: Interactions with Clients, Partners, and Suppliers
chunk: Ensure all client interactions align with company values. Review contracts for ethical compliance. Foster strong, ethical relationships with partners.
Employees are encouraged to report any unethical behavior or violations of this policy.
Directly to a manager or HR representative. Anonymously through a designated whistleblower hotline.
Employees who report concerns in good faith will not face retaliation.
Promote a culture of openness and transparency. Ensure employees know how to report concerns. Address reports promptly and fairly.
Violations of this Code of Conduct may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination.
Verbal or written warnings. Suspension or demotion. Termination for severe breaches.
Document all violations and disciplinary actions. Ensure consistency in applying disciplinary measures. Provide employees with opportunities to improve.

1. What should I do if I witness unethical behavior? Report it to your manager or HR immediately. 2. Can I accept gifts from clients? Only nominal gifts are acceptable; anything beyond that must be reported. 3. What if I am unsure about a potential conflict of interest? Disclose your concerns to your manager or HR for guidance. 4. How is confidentiality maintained? Follow company protocols for data handling and sharing. 5. What protections do I have if I report a violation? You are protected from retaliation if you report in good faith. 6. What constitutes harassment? Any unwanted behavior that creates a hostile work environment. 7. Are there consequences for violating this policy? Yes, disciplinary actions can range from warnings to termination. By adhering to this Code of Conduct & Ethics Policy, we can collectively uphold the values that define Global Service Firm and ensure a respectful and ethical workplace for all.
